description:
Something goes wrong. Then what?

You're the one in the scenario. Each episode is a cinematic, second-person walk through what actually happens next, minute by minute: what your body does in the first sixty seconds, why the ship can't just stop, who's flying the plane when the pilot goes down, and the one thing that decides how it ends.

Survival, what-ifs, your body, space, and the mysteries nobody has quite solved. Every number is sourced or rounded. Danger is real, never graphic. Footage is AI-generated to illustrate each scenario; no real incident is depicted.

New episodes every week. Subscribe and you'll be here for the next one.

That's what.
